static_preprod_genesis_crosscheck.source: captured official Preprod Shelley genesis, not a live response

genesis_provider_contract.rule: integer coercion only from documented string fields; unexpected extra fields retained raw, not rejected

tip_contract.block_no: deprecated; if present non-bool integer; tip height-field inconsistency in source is retained, not repaired

epoch_params_contract.query: exactly one explicit _epoch_no equal to step-2 epoch_no; omitted/all-history query forbidden
epoch_params_contract.max_tx_size_and_budgets: present fields must be null (explicit qualification flag) or non-bool integer >= 0; raw values only
epoch_params_contract.cost_models: null or object retained opaque; any other shape flagged unsupported; format unknown in all cases; cannot cost-evaluate

address_utxos_contract.top_level: array, 0..1000 rows; empty is a valid provider-reported unfunded observation
address_utxos_contract.exactly_1000_rows: bounded set only; possible truncation flag; no completeness claim; Content-Range retained if present

row.tx_index: non-bool integer 0..32767 (SQL smallint source bound; negative rejected)
row.value: raw non-negative decimal string; no ADA/lovelace conversion or sum
row.asset_list_inline_datum_reference_script: retained raw only; no tx building, fee, unit, or cost inference

json_and_http.status: 200 only; non-200 body captured if within bound but never accepted
json_and_http.canonical_url: response URL must equal requested URL exactly
json_and_http.content_type: application/json only; only content-type and content-range response headers are retained
json_and_http.body_bound: <= 2097152 bytes checked before persist/JSON; Scrapling buffers whole body first, so this is not a streaming cap

bracket_and_funding_language.changed_tip_or_epoch: AMBIGUOUS; not an atomic or authenticated snapshot; no silent retry
forbidden_claims: complete UTxO set at exactly 1000 rows
